justification.statement: words.power(w, n) writes w n times, or the inverse of w -n times
justification.text: The entry recurses on n: n = 0 gives the empty word, n > 0 gives w followed by power(w, n - 1), and n < 0 gives the inverse of w followed by power(w, n + 1).

reason.statement: words.power(w, n) writes w n times, or the inverse of w -n times
reason.idea: Doing a word n times is writing it n times; doing it a negative number of times is doing its inverse that many times.

failure.outcome: weaker conclusion: the type checker refuses a non-integer n before any run, so the entry says nothing about it

by_hand.not_meant: power builds a literal word and never reduces it: power(w, 2) followed by power(w, -2) is a word four times as long as w, not the empty word, though its effect is the identity.

steps.check: n = -1: the inverse of w once, its letters reversed and each negated: [2, -1].
